units: <cite ref="Taanit 24b">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבי דא׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דחיטין דפרזינא</he>; Ms. M. <he>דפרזינאי</he>) ships of the Arzanians. Fem. *<he>אַרְזַנְיָיתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 70a">Git. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>חיטין א׳</he> Arzanian wheat (of a large size).
